summary: This memo describes the US top-level domains of the early Internet, which placed US organisations under the .us space using geographic names such as states and localities. It was informational and was replaced by RFC 1480.

eli5.summary: Every country gets its own ending for web names, and this paper explains how the United States organised the names that end in .us. A newer paper later replaced it.

questions: how is the us domain organized
what is the .us top level domain
